summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NavCom Multi-Crew Manifest System. All 14 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with multi-crew toggle, manifest builder, role management, and contract details page. Fixed bug where 'mustering' status contracts were not shown in contracts list.

fixed.issue: Multi-crew contracts with 'mustering' status were not included in contracts list query
fixed.fix: Added 'mustering' status to the $or query in get_contracts endpoint

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/contracts with is_multi_crew=true creates contract with manifest
Backend: GET /api/contracts/:id returns contract with manifest details
Backend: POST /api/contracts/:id/manifest/bid submits bid on crew slot
Backend: Cannot bid on own contract (400 error)
Backend: Cannot bid twice on same slot (400 error)
Backend: DELETE /api/contracts/:id/manifest/bid/:slot_index withdraws bid
Backend: POST /api/contracts/:id/manifest/accept-bid accepts bid and fills slot
Backend: Only owner can accept bids (403 for non-owner)
Backend: POST /api/contracts/:id/deploy deploys team when crew assigned
Backend: Cannot deploy without crew members (400 error)
Backend: Only owner can deploy (403 for non-owner)
Backend: Invalid slot index returns 400 error
Backend: Bidding on non-multi-crew contract returns 400 error
Backend: GET /api/contracts includes multi-crew contracts with 'mustering' status
Frontend: Multi-crew toggle (data-testid='multi-crew-toggle') shows/hides manifest builder
Frontend: ADD ROLE button adds crew slots to manifest
Frontend: Quick fill (×N) adds multiple slots of same role
Frontend: Total payout calculation updates correctly
Frontend: Individual slot payout editing works
Frontend: Remove slot (X button) removes crew slot
Frontend: POST MULTI-CREW BEACON button creates contract
Frontend: Contract details page (/contracts/:id) displays crew roster
Frontend: Crew roster shows role, payout, and OPEN/FILLED status
Frontend: Contracts list shows multi-crew indicator badge (0/N)
Frontend: View Crew Slots button navigates to contract details
